Seasonal doors

Demand comes in waves

The Circle opens seasonally, mentorship applications are reviewed twice a year and the Sanctuary sits behind a waitlist. Between launches, a woman who is ready today has nowhere to say yes.

No bridge

From a reel straight to a 1:1 call

Today the path is a DM reset or a newsletter, then a private alignment call. Nothing in between lets her experience your work first and raise her hand when she’s ready.

Linear growth

Every lead depends on the next post

2,405 posts, a podcast and a Substack in, new applications still rise and fall with how much you publish and speak. That lever is capped by your time.

Most of the women who follow you for your honesty never get an easy way to pay you, and the few ready for private work can’t be told apart from the rest.

My recommendation

A free live masterclass, “Who Am I Now?”, as an always-on front door to everything you already have

The class runs every week from ads, offers the Sanctuary to women not ready for private work, and sends the women who are ready into the application and alignment call you already use.

Fixes the missing masterclass

A free hour with you is an easy yes for a woman who has listened to the podcast for months, and every seat is an email address you own.

Fixes the seasonal doors

The Sanctuary is offered on the thank-you page every week instead of opening from a waitlist, so women can join the month they find you.

Fixes the missing bridge

Only women who attend, stay and apply reach your alignment call, already knowing how you work. Ads keep the class full without you posting more.

The 95%*

Not ready for private work yet

They take the free class, join The Right Room Sanctuary from $22/month and stay close through the monthly lessons and the live group hour. You get paid to start the relationship.

The qualified 5%

Ready to go deeper with you

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them, and the pre-call emails prepare them for your alignment call.

With Hilary Phelps

Who this class is for

The early years were about staying the course. This class is about what comes next.

  • Life looks steady from the outside, and something still feels quietly unfinished.
  • The old story has ended, and the new one hasn’t quite started yet.
  • She has done the work, and wants to know who she is beyond it.
  • She’s ready for rooms, relationships and goals that fit the woman she is now.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

The quiet collapse

Why high-functioning women can feel stuck years in, even when everything looks fine on paper.

The identity gap

What happens between the end of the old story and the start of the new one, and why it’s a normal stage, not a setback.

“I’m not wrong, I’m just in the wrong room”

How to notice when a room, a role or a relationship no longer fits, and what to do about it.

A 5-minute reset you can use daily

A simple practice to quiet the noise and hear your own voice again.

Your next three steps

A clear starting point for rebuilding an identity that feels like yours.

Meet Hilary

Hi, I’m Hilary Phelps

I’m an identity coach, speaker and the host of The Right Room. I’m 19 years sober and co-author of Women & Addiction (Hay House).

I help women years into sobriety rediscover who they are. My work blends coaching with practices from yoga, Pilates, EFT tapping and mindfulness, and it all comes back to one idea: you’re not wrong, you may just be in the wrong room.
